steps.headline: Session dots have no shadow, glow or ring; each colour adjusts itself to stay visible on the wallpaper.
steps.changed: Removed the dark backing and the soft glow. On Meadow Mist's blue, red deepens to a dark red and idle dots are a quiet slate; green, blue and amber only shift when they would otherwise disappear. On dark themes the dots are unchanged.
steps.notice: The header icons and the selected Chat button are exactly as the last session left them — you haven't judged those yet, so judge the whole header here.
steps.risk: A deep red on a mid-blue wallpaper is less bright than the usual red. It can never turn pink or neon, but it can look darker than you expect.

steps.headline: The small status buttons under the message box are more solid, so their text is easier to read.
steps.changed: They now let at most 15% of the wallpaper through (was 42% on Meadow Mist). The quick buttons above the message box and the message box itself are unchanged.
steps.notice: "Meadow Mist" and "Sonnet | Auto Effort" were the hardest to read before; they still read less strongly than the others.
steps.risk: The status row looks slightly less see-through than the quick buttons above it.
